Anya (People Ops): Heads-up — looks like the Greenhouse interview form mapping broke this morning. Several panel scorecards are saving as 'N/A' and the 'overall recommendation' field isn't populating. Not sure if this is a webhook change or someone edited the template. @Matt can you check?
Matt (Recruiter): Thanks for flagging. I saw a couple of candidates with empty fields. I think this started after yesterday's CSV import for the SRE hiring batch. I can repro on my side.
Dina (Hiring Manager): Ugh, saw that on two interviews this morning. The rubric fields are there when I open the form but GH shows N/A in the aggregated view. Makes calibration impossible.
Samir (Eng): I grabbed the payload from the webhook — the form ids look off. Possible schema shift: the keys we use to map -> ATS columns changed. Snippet: ```json
{"mapping": {"overall_fit": "fit_score_v2", "technical": "tech_score", "communication": null}}
```
Anya (People Ops): Good find. Matt, did the recruiter-batch import change our mapping template? We have a documented mapping at https://go.redwood/ops/gh-form but maybe the CSV tool overwrote it.
Matt (Recruiter): I ran a one-off script to normalize names and it touched the mapping file. My bad — I meant to test in staging. Rolling back now.
recruiter-bot: :information_source: Deploy rollback initiated by @Matt. Rolling back mapping config to commit 9f7a2c.
Matt (Recruiter): Rollback complete. Can folks re-check an affected candidate? I also pushed a hotfix to prevent null keys from being inserted.
Dina (Hiring Manager): Rechecked one profile — aggregated view now shows scores. :relieved: But we should still run a quick calibration session — at least one interviewer used a different scale yesterday.
Anya (People Ops): Agreed. Let's schedule a 30-min interviewer calibration tomorrow 11am PT. I'll update the interviewer training doc and add a checklist to validate mappings before big imports: https://go.redwood/ops/interviewer-training.
Samir (Eng): For long-term: can we add an automated test that validates the GH mapping after imports? I can add a lightweight lambda that hits the webhook in staging and asserts field names.
Matt (Recruiter): Yes please — that'll catch this early. Also adding a README note for recruiters: never run the normalizer on production mapping files without a staging pass.
Anya (People Ops): Action items: 1) Matt: postmortem note in #people-ops (brief) and add rollback timeline. 2) Samir: quick auto-test in staging (small PR). 3) All interviewers: attend 11am PT calibration (calendar invite sent). 4) I'll update the interviewer training checklist and add a pre-import validation step.
Dina (Hiring Manager): Thanks all. If anyone sees stray N/A records, tag me and I'll hold grading until we confirm integrity.
Matt (Recruiter): Posted a short thread in #recruiting with the root cause and rollback details. Sorry for the noisy morning — lesson learned. :coffee:
recruiter-bot: :white_check_mark: Verified — mapping values present in 100% of sampled recent submissions.
